界面语言只影响 NodeCloak，不改变浏览器副本的语言或终端 locale。: Interface language affects NodeCloak only. Browser profile languages and terminal locales stay unchanged.

读取专用配置中的 WebRTC 策略，配置后仍需网页实测。此设置可能影响网页语音: Read the WebRTC policy in the dedicated profile. Verify its actual behavior in the browser. This setting may affect audio/video calls.
将专用浏览器设置为严格 DNS over HTTPS。企业策略或代理可能覆盖设置: Configure strict DNS over HTTPS in the dedicated browser. Enterprise policies or proxies may override it. This does not constitute a DNS leak test.
配置文件包含强制中文语言，普通偏好无法覆盖。系统或企业策略还需在浏览器 poli: The profile forces Chinese languages, which ordinary preferences cannot override. Check system or enterprise policies on the browser's policy page.

可选新加坡（UTC+8）、UTC（UTC+0）或系统支持的自定义时区。新加坡不会: Choose Singapore (UTC+8), UTC (UTC+0) or a system-supported custom timezone. Singapore retains the UTC+8 offset. UTC displays time 8 hours earlier than Beijing time. This affects the entire system and can be restored from history.

4g 是连接质量估计等级，并不证明使用了蜂窝网络。: 4g is an estimated connection quality class. It does not prove cellular network use.

UA 推断与 Emoji 渲染需分开确认: Verify UA inference and emoji rendering separately

读取专用 Firefox 的启动偏好与运行偏好；配置写入不等于实际网页检测通过。: Read the dedicated Firefox profile's startup and runtime preferences. Written settings do not prove observed web checks passed.

设置浏览器语言与定位权限。时区跟随电脑，地理位置由浏览器处理。: Set browser language and location permissions. Timezone follows the computer; location is handled by the browser.

按代理出口国家匹配常用语言；启动时会在浏览器内再次确认。按域名分流时，检测服务与: Match common languages to the proxy exit country; the browser checks again at launch. With domain-based routing, the lookup service and destination website may use different exits.

若时间同步后网页仍提示 Incorrect device time，请改用自定义: If Incorrect device time persists after syncing, use a custom browser language, disable strict fingerprint protection and restart the profile. Check the proxy connection and browser verification separately.
读取系统时区标识。修改时区只改变本地时间显示，不会校准电脑时钟；时间准确性请查看: Reads the system timezone identifier. Changing timezone affects local time display but does not sync the clock. See the separate system clock check for accuracy. Changes affect all applications and can be restored from history.

已处理。同步状态已更新。: Resolved. Sync status has been updated.
选择本机要上传的副本，以及要接收的云端副本。: Choose local profiles to upload and cloud profiles to receive.
本机数据已保留。请逐个选择要保留的内容，其他副本可继续同步。: Your local data is safe. Choose what to keep for each profile below. Other profiles can continue syncing.
请检查网络后重试，当前本机数据会保留。: Check your connection and retry. Your current local data will be kept.
将自动重试，无需选择保留哪一份。: Sync will retry automatically. You do not need to choose a version to keep.
点击“立即同步”重试，或开启自动同步。: Select Sync now to retry, or enable automatic sync.
你仍可点击“立即同步”，手动同步已关联的副本。: You can still select Sync now to sync linked profiles manually.
在不同设备上接着使用，登录状态会在副本关闭后同步。: Continue across devices. Sign-in data syncs after you close a profile.
同步检查已完成，请查看下方状态。: Sync check finished. See the status below.
上次同步未完成: The last sync did not finish
只处理下面这些副本，无需重新设置全部同步。: Only these profiles need a decision. You do not need to set up sync again.
两台设备对配置有不同修改: Two devices made different configuration changes
登录状态需要确认: Choose which sign-in data to keep
此副本需要重新检查同步状态: This profile needs another sync check
先处理配置，再处理登录状态: Resolve configuration first, then sign-in data
云端记录缺失，请先重新同步配置；本机登录数据已保留。: The cloud record is missing. Sync configuration again first. Local sign-in data has been kept.
等待另一台设备释放登录数据后再同步。: Wait for the other device to release the sign-in data, then sync again.
另一台设备的后续更改可能产生冲突。请先确认那台设备已结束使用。: Later changes from the other device may conflict. Make sure that device has finished using this profile first.
一台设备删除了此副本，另一台设备仍有修改。选择已删除的一方会同时删除另一方；本机: One device deleted this profile while another changed it. Choosing the deleted version also deletes the other version. Local deletions can be restored from Recently deleted.
选择一份配置继续使用，或将本机版本另存为一个副本。: Choose a configuration to use, or save the local version as a separate profile.
两台设备的登录数据都有变化。请选择要继续使用的登录状态，或保留一个本机副本。: Sign-in data changed on both devices. Choose which version to use, or keep a separate local copy.
将采用本机的配置或删除状态，并覆盖云端配置。若本机已删除，云端也会删除。: Use the local configuration or deletion state and overwrite the cloud version. If deleted locally, it will also be deleted in the cloud.
保留这台设备的配置，并覆盖云端配置。: Keep this device's configuration and overwrite the cloud configuration.
用这台设备的登录数据覆盖云端登录状态。其他设备下次同步时会采用这份数据。: Overwrite cloud sign-in data with this device's data. Other devices will use it on their next sync.
用这台设备的配置更新云端: Update the cloud with this device's configuration
用本机登录数据更新云端: Update the cloud with local sign-in data
将采用云端的配置或删除状态。若云端已删除，本机副本也会移到“最近删除”。: Use the cloud configuration or deletion state. If deleted in the cloud, the local profile will move to Recently deleted.
使用云端配置，覆盖这台设备上尚未同步的配置修改。: Use the cloud configuration and overwrite unsynced configuration changes on this device.
用云端登录数据替换本机登录状态，当前本机的登录变化将被覆盖。: Replace local sign-in data with the cloud version. Current local sign-in changes will be overwritten.
将云端配置应用到这台设备: Apply the cloud configuration to this device
将云端登录数据应用到本机: Apply cloud sign-in data to this device
把本机版本另存为新副本，再将云端版本应用到原副本。若云端已删除，原副本会移到“最: Save the local version as a new profile, then apply the cloud version to the original. If deleted in the cloud, the original will move to Recently deleted.
本机另存一份，原副本采用云端: Save a local copy; use the cloud version for the original
等待下一次同步检查。: Waiting for the next sync check.
通常只需等待。若另一台设备已退出但仍无法同步，可以接管登录数据。: Usually, you can just wait. If the other device has exited but sync is still blocked, you can take over the sign-in data.
这些副本已关联云端。停止同步会保留本机副本和云端数据。: These profiles are linked to the cloud. Stopping sync keeps both local profiles and cloud data.
本机副本和云端数据都会保留。这台设备不再接收或上传此副本的变化。: Both the local profile and cloud data will be kept. This device will stop receiving and uploading changes for this profile.
点击“选择同步副本”开始，本机浏览器数据会保留。: Select Choose profiles to get started. Local browser data will be kept.
勾选要在设备间使用的副本。取消勾选只停止关联，不删除副本。: Select profiles to use across devices. Unchecking stops the link without deleting profiles.
同步设置已保存，请查看最新同步状态。: Sync settings saved. Check the latest sync status.
已暂不同步，可随时选择同步副本。: Sync is off for now. You can choose profiles at any time.
副本列表暂未获取，当前同步状态仍会保留。: The profile list is unavailable. Current sync status has been kept.
同步数据经过加密。不同设备同时修改同一内容时，才需要你选择。: Synced data is encrypted. You only need to choose when devices change the same content differently.
请查看下方具体原因后重试，本机数据会保留。: Review the specific error below and retry. Local data will be kept.
登录同步暂时无法读取本机浏览器数据（{0}；本机数据已保留）: Sign-in sync temporarily cannot read local browser data ({0}; local data has been preserved)

导入节点后可查看连接参数；不支持的传输选项会明确提示。: Import a node to view connection settings. Unsupported transport options are reported explicitly.

节点参数不支持或格式无效，请检查 TLS 和传输设置: Unsupported or invalid node settings. Check TLS and transport.
节点 UUID 无效，请重新导入节点链接: Invalid node UUID. Import the node link again.
普通代理不能附带节点参数: Standard proxies cannot contain node settings
节点代理不支持 API 提取或代理用户名: Node proxies cannot use API extraction or a proxy username
副本代理内核未就绪；请重新导入节点或重启副本: The profile proxy core is not ready. Import the node again or restart the profile.
副本代理内核已退出，请重新启动副本: The profile proxy core has exited. Restart the profile.
已安全保存；留空保留原 UUID: Saved securely; leave blank to keep the UUID
节点认证信息为空，请重新导入节点链接: Node authentication is empty. Import the node link again.
请粘贴 VLESS、VMess 或 Hysteria2 节点链接: Paste a VLESS, VMess or Hysteria2 node link
已安全保存；留空保留原认证信息: Securely saved; leave blank to keep existing authentication

Hysteria2 需要支持 UDP 的 SOCKS5 前置代理: Hysteria2 requires a SOCKS5 first hop with UDP support
